description: Timed on-chain Flappy Bird with provably fair TEE-generated pipe layouts. Pick a flight route and tap to fly through pipes — every flap is recorded in a Morpheus TEE session for deterministic replay. Pay a small GAS entry, clear the route target before the deadline, and win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Meadow Hop (5 pipes), 0.5 for Sky Sprint (10 pipes), 1 for Pipe Gauntlet (20 pipes). All-or-nothing payout: reach the target to win, crash and you lose the entry. Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上 Flappy Bird，管道布局由 TEE 保证可验证公平。选择飞行路线并点击让鸟儿穿越管道——每次拍翼都会被记录在 Morpheus TEE 会话中，用于确定性回放。支付少量 GAS 报名费，在截止时间内穿越路线目标管道即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：草地起飞 0.1（5 根管道）、云端冲刺 0.5（10 根）、管道试炼 1（20 根）。全有或全无：达到目标即获胜，撞管则输掉报名费。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。
name: Flappy Dash

operations.name: Take Off

operation_panel.title: Flappy Dash

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Pipe layouts are generated inside a Morpheus TEE enclave from a deterministic seed. The seed is derived from the game id, player, and difficulty, so every participant gets a reproducible layout. The commitment is bound on-chain before the run begins; at settlement the TEE signs the state hash after replaying all recorded flaps.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
